Space & Astronomy

N-Body Orbital Sandbox

Active

A browser-based gravity simulator for exploring how multiple bodies interact under Newtonian gravitation. Use it to test initial conditions, inspect orbital paths and prototype mechanics for later space-science visualisations.

Flow Around Objects

In progress

A browser-based two-dimensional fluid-flow simulation using a D2Q9 lattice Boltzmann model. Compare air or water flowing around an aerofoil, square or cylinder, inspect pressure and vorticity fields, and observe drag, lift and vortex shedding. It is an educational model, not an experimentally validated CFD tool.

  • JavaScript

  • Lattice Boltzmann
